basic_info.description: This historic 2-level loft in Dogpatch, originally a cooperage and later Esprit Clothing headquarters, offers a unique blend of past and present living. It features a rare, private, street-side entrance, gracious patio, and serene courtyard views, with an open-plan interior boasting high ceilings, natural light, and industrial chic elements. The loft includes a cozy upper level bedroom, lower level office which can be converted to private 2nd bedroom, smart living features, and convenient parking and storage, all within a vibrant neighborhood with parks, restaurants, and easy access to major attractions.  The well run HOA features Google Fiber, facial recognition technology, dedicated bike rooms, private storage, intimate courtyards and on-site property management. Homes on Esprit Park is an amazing place to live and thrive in Dogpatch and this loft is one of the rare, brick and timber, private entrance residences within its confines. Don't miss it!
